_comment: AV (Abomination Vaults) family project terms. Loaded by build_3source_tm.py as the `wiki_project` tier - it outranks pf2_cn/pf2e_compendium, so only put terms here that the general wiki layer cannot answer or answers wrongly for this adventure. Every entry records where the ruling came from; `note` explains anything a later reader would otherwise re-litigate.

Abomination Vaults.note: Variants seen in the wild and normalised away: 憎恶秘库 / 憎恶宝库 / 诅咒秘库 / 深渊宝库 / 憎恨地窟 / 憎恶魔窟 / 憎恶地窟. pf2e_compendium_chn itself still carries 憎恶魔窟 x12 against 憎恨魔窟 x64.

Menace Under Otari.note: No wiki page. glossary.json had 奥塔利之危, which both mis-spells the town (奥塔利) and drops the 'under'.

Otari.note: Both the town and the founder. Variants normalised away: 奥塔利 / 欧塔里.

Belcorra Haruvex.note: The old glossary regex had chopped this to a bare 哈鲁维克斯.

Belcorra's Grasp.source: AV:E corpus, 5:1 over 贝科拉的掌控

Nhimbaloth's Shrine.source: AV corpus, 2:1 over 宁布洛斯的圣祠

Morlock.note: Absent from the pre-refresh TM entirely.

Ilvarandin.note: Not used anywhere in the AV corpus; recorded so a later book does not invent a second rendering.

Fogfen.note: The wiki Data page says the shorter 雾沼, but the book prose and the AV corpus (27:1) say 雾隐沼泽. The one dissenting use was a playlist track title, now unified.

Sanctuary.note: The SPELL. AV area I43 is also called Sanctuary but is a hidden resting cave - rendered 避难所 there, not with the spell name. A term table cannot express that; it is pinned in 冒险/AV/qa/_terms.json instead.

Drill Field.note: An earlier pass had the playlist entry as 钻研领域, reading 'drill' as study.

Tianze.source: the module's own adventure entry name (天泽的凄凉灯塔额外内容)
Tianze.note: Beat 天则 3:2 in the workspace; the entry name settles it.
